recommendation: No single in-boundary Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite) design satisfies all five criteria. Achieved in-boundary: volumetric ED >= 950 Wh/L (ED-Compact B 951.7 / B-p 964.4 Wh/L) and SEI <= 500 nm after 100 cycles (404.6 / 417.7 nm; baseline 449.1 nm). Not achievable in-boundary (boundary: ceiling_escalation OFF, only task-named materials/systems, Chen2020 architecture/formulation + cooling h 10-25): (1) voltage plateau >= 4.1 V - cathode OCP caps midpoint at ~4.0 V (best measured 3.998 V, Rate-4C); requires 4.7 V-class cathode (LNMO-class midpoint 4.17 V) - system switch excluded; (2) plating-free 4C charge at ED >= 950 - the compaction that yields 950 Wh/L destroys 4C transport (all ED-passers plate at 4C, anode min -0.26 to -0.29 V); plating-free corner measured at ED 769 Wh/L (Rate-4C R1, anode min +0.0144 V, 4C acceptance 0.41 Ah before voltage limit); (3) T_max <= 50 C at 4C/45 C - best measured 336.4 K at max in-boundary cooling (Rate-4C-h25); heat rejection hA capped at 0.133 W/K (A=0.00531 m2 locked, h<=25) vs ~1.5+ W/K needed. Recommendation: ED-champion family ED-Compact B/B-p for the energy-density objective (derated fast charge, thermal envelope redesign required), or Rate-4C R1 as the fast-charge-capable design at 769 Wh/L. Full relaxation mapping in escalation.questions.
